messages:
Amina (CEO): Morning team — quick weekstart note. Three top priorities this week: 1) Private (EU) GA readiness and docs lock, 2) 95th‑pct latency reduction target for hosted inference (-10%), 3) finalize Dedicated pricing cadence for Q2. Also: infra spend was +6% last week vs plan — please call out any unexpected cost drivers.

Raj Patel (VP Eng): Ack. Will confirm canary schedule for model v1.4 by Wed EOD. Planning staggered canary across two Dedicated clusters + hosted fallback. @mike and @sasha on it.

Clara Ng (VP Product): We aim to freeze GA docs tomorrow. Running one final privacy audit with legal on Wed AM. Question: any retention changes needed for EU GA? If so flag now.

Miguel Soto (Head SRE): Kernel security patching approved for Thu night. Low risk, but expect a 6–8 min rolling restart per node. Will post maintenance window and ops runbook. Also FYI — yesterday we had a short spike tied to a bad batcher config, mitigated via throttle. No customer impact.

Zoe Kim (Dir DevEx): Sharing a quick checklist for GA and runbook templates: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/ga-checklist :rocket: I can help with final docs and the onboarding checklist.

Raj Patel (VP Eng): quick note — canary command for reference:
```bash
./deploy --cluster dedicated-eu-canary --model v1.4 --percent 5
```
I’ll update the schedule in the deploy board.

Clara Ng (VP Product): Retention: legal prefers 90d by default for EU, need engineering confirmation on snapshot pruning timeline.

Miguel Soto (Head SRE): 90d is fine from infra side, but storage costs bump noted — will surface numbers in the Thurs sync.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: dedicated-eu-canary at 2023-06-14T22:00Z (initiated by Raj Patel). Status: pending.

Amina (CEO): Thanks all. Two asks before Thurs sync: 1) Raj — post the canary runbook link here, 2) Clara — confirm GA doc freeze and list any remaining open privacy items. If cost delta looks like a trend, product/eng ops to propose mitigations. Sync Thurs 10am PT — please be prepared with 1 slide each. :eyes:
